description_en: Queries the trend of the number of auto triggered node instances within a specified period of time
description_zh: 获取指定时间段周期实例数量的趋势
name: ListInstanceAmount

parameters.help_en: The DataWorks workspace ID. You can log on to the DataWorks console and go to the Work space page to obtain the workspace ID
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks管控台，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query, accurate to the day. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 开始业务日期，精确到天。该参数需要配置为yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssZ的UTC格式
parameters.name: begin_date

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query, accurate to the day. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 结束业务日期，精确到天。该参数需要配置为yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssZ的UTC格式
parameters.name: end_date

InstanceCounts.description_en: The trend of the number of auto triggered node instances within the specified period of time
InstanceCounts.description_zh: 周期实例数量在指定时间段的趋势数据

Count.description_en: The number of auto triggered node instances

Date.description_en: The data timestamp at which the number of auto triggered node instances was obtained. This value is a UNIX timestamp
Date.description_zh: 获取周期实例数量的业务日期，此处显示业务日期对应的时间戳

RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。用于出现错误后排查问题
